classification: independent T2 source research only; optional T3 not performed
unmetNeed: Import raw Stryker or Tautest report as advisory evidence while treating stale or hand-edited unsigned reports as lower trust; no execution inside gate.

policies.contributing: Welcomes concrete professional feedback; do not write feedback before it occurs.
policies.cleanRoom: Own words/code, cite inspiration, preserve MIT attribution/notices for copied material; no AGPL/Elastic code copying.
